basic_profile.bio: A passionate Yu-Gi-Oh! enthusiast hailing from Portland, Oregon. With a deep love for strategy games, I've been hooked on Yu-Gi-Oh! since my early teens. I work as a software developer, which gives me a keen analytical edge when building decks. In my free time, I enjoy going on road trips in my Mazdaspeed3 and listening to the discography of amazarashi. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, especially after work and on weekends. Currently single and enjoying the freedom it brings to explore my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in programming and software development, having earned a degree in Computer Science. My passion for card games led me to delve deep into the mechanics of Yu-Gi-Oh!, learning through both online communities and local tournaments. I've accumulated a wealth of knowledge through years of playing and interacting with other duelists.
